per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP DBAASPR_14244 and CAMP CAMPSQ10076 rows match the primary paper after source review: mature RbLEAP-2 sequence is located in Fig. 1, literature metadata matches DOI/PMID/PMCID, and all five MIC rows match Table 2 including V. campbellii after abbreviation/spacing normalization.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The valid activity layer is five Table 2 MIC rows. Scaffold rows that misread the temperature column as MIC were removed. No local source supports hemolysis/cytotoxicity or exact OD540 values, and none are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct antimicrobial activity is source-supported, but no direct molecular killing mechanism is reported. Structural/disulfide and expression-response evidence remains contextual and bounded.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Article text says mature peptide region 58-93 aa, while Fig. 1 boxed mature peptide and DBAASP/CAMP sequence rows support the 46 aa mature sequence ending VNY.
Local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database evidence has MIC activity rows but no hemolysis/cytotoxicity assay table.
The paper provides MIC, structural prediction, and expression context, not a direct membrane/intracellular target mechanism assay.
